Options -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html index.php
AddDefaultCharset UTF-8
AddType "text/csv; charset=UTF-8" .csv
AddType image/svg+xml .svg
AddType font/woff2 .woff2

# Never serve data or database files, wherever they end up.
<FilesMatch "\.(sqlite|sqlite-wal|sqlite-shm|log|toml|md|py)$">
  <IfModule mod_authz_core.c>
    Require all denied
  </IfModule>
</FilesMatch>

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  # Force HTTPS (uncomment once the certificate is active)
  # RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
  # RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]
  RewriteRule ^private/ - [F,L]
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
  <FilesMatch "^cjenik\.csv$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"
  </FilesMatch>
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|svg|woff2|jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
  </FilesMatch>
  <FilesMatch "\.html$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=300"
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml text/csv
</IfModule>
